correctness.rationale: Exhaustive 59,203-face enumeration agrees with an independent 2^15 undirected-forest orientation enumerator. Every one of 333,390 Hasse incidences is included in the topological-sort acyclicity certificate for 29,464 matching pairs. Signed integral Morse boundaries are constructed from explicit ±1 elementary eliminations, and exact row/column unit reductions leave zero remainder with ranks 5,53,4. All chain products vanish. Betti ranks 12,1,44,94 and torsion-freeness follow over Z, while the ordinary CW model with one vertex and no 1-,2-,3-cells proves 3-connectivity and the stated Hurewicz consequence. Direct mod-two boundary reduction agrees as a separate check; it is not substituted for the integer proof. The finite scope is explicit.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is the unique cubic graph of girth five on ten vertices; bidirection is a canonical extension of the previously studied paths and cycles. The exact integral absence of torsion together with unexpectedly spread nonzero homology in four consecutive dimensions and 3-connectivity supplies a natural benchmark for topology of cycle-free partial-permutation complexes. Its relevance comes from a natural graph and structural homology pattern, not arbitrary slice selection or computational novelty by itself. No larger-family implication is claimed.
